name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  rubocop:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1.260.0
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.4.6'
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: bundle exec rubocop

  typescript:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'yarn'
      - name: Install Yarn dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Run TypeScript checks
        run: yarn run typecheck:full

  graphql_lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'yarn'
      - name: Install Yarn dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Run GraphQL schema linter
        run: npx graphql-schema-linter app/graphql/**/*.rb

  factory_bot_lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
          POSTGRES_DB: vglist_development
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1.260.0
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.4.6'
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Setup database
        run: |
          bundle exec rails db:create
          bundle exec rails db:schema:load
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5432/vglist_development
      - name: Run FactoryBot lint
        run: bundle exec rake spec:factories
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5432/vglist_development

  rspec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
          POSTGRES_DB: vglist_development
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1.260.0
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.4.6'
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Setup database
        run: |
          bundle exec rails db:create
          bundle exec rails db:schema:load
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5432/vglist_development
      - name: Run RSpec tests
        run: bundle exec rspec
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5432/vglist_development
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          file: ./coverage/.resultset.json
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella

  db_seed:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: password
          POSTGRES_DB: vglist_development
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1.260.0
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.4.6'
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Setup database
        run: |
          bundle exec rails db:create
          bundle exec rails db:schema:load
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5432/vglist_development
      - name: Seed database
        run: bundle exec rails db:seed
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5432/vglist_development
